visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The shot opens with an eye-level close-up of an indoor aquarium. The water is clear, containing dark granular substrate at the base. Clusters of green Java moss are positioned on the right side. Two adult Convict Cichlids with distinct black vertical stripes are swimming slowly in the mid-ground. The lighting is consistent and bright from above. (2) The camera smoothly zooms in towards the lower-left corner of the tank. Numerous tiny, almost transparent fry are seen hovering just above the gravel. Their movements are characterized by quick, jittery bursts. An adult fish enters from the right, its fins moving rhythmically to maintain position near the offspring. (3) The camera pans slightly left, following the movement of the adult fish as it hovers over the fry. The background remains a plain, out-of-focus light wall visible through the glass. The adult fish appears alert, occasionally making small lunges toward the glass as the observer moves. (4) A final close-up focuses on the fry darting between the moss filaments and the open water. The adult fish is seen in the periphery, acting as a guard. The overall visual atmosphere is calm and focused on the micro-ecosystem.
